note: Deterministic demo runs. Each one resets nothing by itself; POST /demo/reset first for a clean trail.

scenarios.title: Agent discovers, prices and buys
scenarios.narrative: A buyer agent is handed a bounded mandate and the goal 'buy a wireless mouse under 1500'. It searches the machine-readable catalog, picks the Aurora Wireless Optical Mouse on a stated rationale, raises a purchase intent, clears all nine guardrails, opens a Razorpay order plus payment link, and settles on a signature-verified webhook.
watch_for: Every check listed in order with a reason on GET /intents/{id}/decision
Intent flips to PAID only after the webhook signature verifies
Mandate spent_paise moves from 0 to 129900

scenarios.title: Budget exhausted, agent re-plans
scenarios.narrative: The mandate allows INR 5,000 total with an INR 4,500 per-transaction cap. The agent buys a mouse for INR 1,299, leaving INR 3,701. A purchase is then attempted for the INR 4,499 mechanical keyboard: it clears the per-transaction cap with INR 1 to spare, but breaches what is actually left, so the budget guardrail denies it and names the exact shortfall. The agent re-searches under the remaining budget and buys the INR 2,499 wireless keyboard instead.
watch_for: per_txn_cap PASSes and budget_remaining FAILs - the two bounds are distinct
The denial states the shortfall in rupees, not just 'insufficient funds'
The agent comes back with a cheaper keyboard rather than retrying the same one

scenarios.title: High-value purchase waits for a human
scenarios.narrative: The agent goes after a 7,999 INR pair of headphones. Every guardrail passes, but the amount is at or above the human-review threshold, so the decision is gate_for_human rather than auto_approve. Budget is reserved while the intent waits, and the dashboard shows an Approve / Reject control. Nothing charges until a person clicks.
watch_for: Decision action gate_for_human with the threshold quoted
Mandate reserved_paise is held at 799900 while it waits
POST /policy/resolve re-runs every other guardrail before approving

scenarios.title: Off-scope category refused
scenarios.narrative: The mandate authorises electronics and office supplies only. The agent is asked for a yoga mat. The category check fails, the intent is denied, and no budget is reserved. The agent recognises this is not something a cheaper product would fix and stops.
watch_for: category_allowed check FAILs and every later check is marked skipped
reserved_paise stays at 0 - a denial never holds money

scenarios.title: Out of stock mid-flow
scenarios.narrative: The agent searches for a wireless mouse while it is in stock, and the last unit sells to someone else before the intent is raised. The stock guardrail refuses the sale rather than charging for something the merchant cannot ship. The agent reads the failed check, excludes that product and re-searches inside the same run, offering an in-stock alternative.
watch_for: stock_available FAILs with the exact count, mid-run
An agent step 'replan' excludes the dead product and searches again
The run still ends in a completed purchase

scenarios.title: Card declined, budget released
scenarios.narrative: An approved purchase reaches checkout, then the card is declined. A signature-verified payment.failed webhook moves the intent to FAILED and releases the budget hold, so a charge that never succeeded does not quietly consume the buyer's budget.
watch_for: intent.failed audit row explaining the hold was released rather than spent
Mandate spent_paise is unchanged and reserved_paise returns to 0

scenarios.title: Tampered mandate rejected
scenarios.narrative: A mandate token is edited to raise its own spending cap. Signature verification fails immediately, the intent never reaches the other guardrails, and the attempt is still written to the audit trail.
watch_for: mandate_valid FAILs on the signature, not on the amount
The rejected attempt still appears in the audit trail

scenarios.title: Merchant upsells, agent takes the better product
scenarios.narrative: The agent picks a wireless mouse, then asks the merchant what it will offer. The growth agent proposes three things and the margin gauntlet judges each. The buyer agent declines the bundle and the volume tier -- it was asked for one mouse and has no authority to buy earphones or three units with its principal's money -- and takes the upgrade, because that is the same job done better with the merchant funding part of the step. Order value rises, and every rejected offer hands its discount back to the campaign.
watch_for: The consider_offers step lists every offer with an accept/decline reason
Declined offers release their discount hold back to the campaign
GET /growth/metrics shows uplift against the no-offer baseline
The intent records the product that actually shipped, not the one searched for

scenarios.title: Merchant refuses to oversell a tight mandate
scenarios.narrative: The same product, the same campaign, but the visiting agent carries a mandate capped at INR 1,500 per purchase. The merchant fits its offers to that bound: anything the buyer could not accept is never made. This is not a checkout-time block -- the offer does not exist. Pushing an agent at a purchase its principal forbade only manufactures a denial and wastes a round trip for both sides.
watch_for: buyer_bounds is the failing check on the withheld offers
The same product under a roomier mandate publishes those offers
Suppressed offers hold no discount budget at all

scenarios.title: The merchant refuses to discount below its floor
scenarios.proves: growth that does not cost margin
scenarios.narrative: Cost price is pushed up on a product until a discount would take it under the campaign's margin floor. The offer builder still proposes -- it cannot see cost, by design -- and the margin gauntlet refuses. The refusal is recorded rather than dropped, which is the only reason the control room can report margin protected as a real number.
watch_for: margin_floor names the exact post-discount margin and the floor it missed
margin_protected_paise on GET /growth/metrics rises by the refused discount
The offer builder never imports the economics module

scenarios.title: A deep discount waits for a human
scenarios.proves: the sell side is gated too
scenarios.narrative: A bundle on the INR 12,499 desk chair gives away more than the campaign's review threshold. Every other margin guardrail passes, so the offer is not suppressed -- it is held, with its discount reserved against the campaign so a second offer cannot overcommit while a person decides. Approving re-runs every other guardrail against current state first: a human waives the depth of the discount, not the margin floor.
watch_for: deep_discount_gate returns GATE, not FAIL -- everything before it passed
The campaign shows the discount held while the offer waits
Approving re-evaluates the whole gauntlet before the offer publishes
